entities.label: Earthquake event
entities.description: The global plate. Values here are the scenario a fixed-scenario function reads; a ShakeMap assembly needs none of them.

entities.label: Bridge

edge.description: The link this bridge carries. An edge with several bridges is open only if all are.

hazus_class.description: HWB1 ... HWB28; selects the fragility parameter set.

entities.description: A bridge, where it is and what kind it is. Its location is what every hazard function reads, so ground motion is one node per bridge.

entities.label: System event

analysis.description: Which system function defines the event: shortest-path or max-flow. Assemblies bind each function to its events with where.

travel_time_tolerance.description: shortest-path: survives if travel time <= (1 + this) x the intact network's. 0.5 allows a journey 50% longer.

min_flow.description: max-flow: survives if the max flow is at least this.

entities.description: One origin-destination performance requirement, defined in the network: which analysis, between which nodes, and what counts as surviving. Each becomes a SystemState node, alongside the travel time or flow it is judged on.
